reviews.x: I got a bruise on my leg and started applying this cream right away.  The bruise was basically gone in 3 days!  Bruises on me normally linger for a couple of weeks so seeing this disappear so quickly was a pleasant surprise!  See the proof in the picture with the bruise before the creme on the left and the bruise after using the creme for just a few days.  I highly recommend it!

reviews.t: I bruise very easily at my age and it does get embarrassing
reviews.x: run do not walk to get this product!  I bruise very easily at my age and it does get embarrassing, this cream takes the bruise away within 48 hrs.

AMAZING!! After surgery I had SERIOUS bruises that were Black/Purple for WEEKS, after the 1st day of using this cream, I already noticed a 50% improvement and now just 5 days later, the bruises are GONE... UNREAL!!!

Trust me, I have tried every product that gets rid of bruises.  I’m cursed with skin that easily bruises.  I’ve always been on the fence with arnica oil based products but a friend suggested trying this one and I am seeing great results.  It has arnica in it, but also some other things that seem to be helping my bruises. Loving it so far!  Highly recommended trying it.

reviews.t: The cream does not VISIBLY reduce the appearance of a bruise.
reviews.x: The cream is a tan color and when first applied it does cover the bruise for about ten seconds until it's absorbed. It is a HUGE overstatement, maybe a lie, to say it reduces the appearance of a bruise.  If you want to hide a bruise, get a concealer! I've tried many things to hasten the healing time from chopped parsley, heat, messaging, arnica, a banana peel, and rubbing the bruise with a warm hard boiled egg. In my experience, the only real cure is to wait it out, usually ten days until a brui

Pretty cool! Bruises gone!  OK. This bruise cream really does work! And it was fast. I had umbilical hernia surgery a few days ago and tried Heladerm to get rid of the 2-3 week significant bruising my doctor said would happen. I sent three pics of my belly in this review to Amazon but they didn't approve the pics (yes, the first few pictures weren't flattering because of the bruises, but they were the real deal!)...bummer because they show/tell the whole story.  Anyway, the first picture was alm

My sister recommended this for rosacea so I tried it and it works great. I had a reaction to a different cream from my dermatologist that made my face redder. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't cause any irritations. I've had acne since I've been a teen and am now in my 50s and for the first time, I've been blemish free since using this for a few months now. It works fine on my bruises, they may go away faster but I use it twice a day after washing my face (on my whole face) more for my comp

reviews.t: A must to have on hand! Bye Bye bruises!
reviews.x: This bruise cream is a must! Of course I always have on hand for any bruises I may get from injectables on my face and it really makes them disappear fast! This cream is a bonus as it has amazing ingredients in it for your skin! Sometimes I just use it as a nighttime cream! I also use it on my daughters when they get bruises on their legs from soccer! Definitely speeds up healing time!
Very disappointed but maybe I was expecting too much. For the cost I did not find it better than other creams that were below half the price.

reviews.t: A cream that really works! Try it.
reviews.x: I've been plagued with "thin blood" bruises ever since I began taking Cumondin many years ago. The bruises just utterly depress me as they're so ugly. After reading the reviews of this product I was greatly encouraged to try it out. I ordered a jar about a month ago and immediately began to apply it to my arms and hands. So far I have had NO bruises on my left arm or hand and just a few small ones on my right hand. Totally blew me away. The jar has lasted about a month but I have no prob

I had dark purple bruising all down the inside of my leg a few days prior to a beach trip and I really didn’t want to go on vacation looking like that! I researched bruise creams and ordered this.  My trick for getting it to work was to apply it and then apply heat over the top of it.  I did this about 3 times a day. After 4-5 days the bruising was almost completely gone.  I had gotten a bruise on my lower leg 3 weeks earlier and it was still showing while the deep purple ones were gone. Highly

I ordered this cream ahead of a scheduled surgery in order to treat post-surgical bruising.  I used it faithfully 3x a day, and by my 10 day postop visit, my bruises were completely gone, to the surprise of my surgeon.  I tend to bruise easily and heal slowly, so I think this says a lot.  Every day, the improvement in my bruising was notable.  It had a weird smell and texture, but the results were phenomenal.  Highly recommended!!

It's a thick facial moisturizer that's great for the winter when it's cold and dry.  The smell is pleasant and not intrusive (very important to me).  The jury is out if it helped speed up the healing of the bruise on my face (arnica gel that I've used in the past didn't seem to speed things up either).  But I will definitely be buying this again in the future.

I normally have used arnica cream in the past when I get a bad bruise, but recently tried this product (also has arnica) and a few other ingredients that look great for healing (like vitamin K). I’m noticing that my bruise is going away a lot faster than in the past. Going to keep using this one!

I certainly will update this review at a later date, but a noticing if you are using this on your face ...be aware...the product leaves a brown residue ...which is the color of the packaged product, but you may not want to use this during the day as it only enhances the already present discoloration you want to treat due to bruising.. VERY disappointing.

I bought this product as it indicated it would heal a bruise in 4 days.  Well, the product does not work.  It is an unpleasant color and smears easily.  The product takes forever to rub into and be absorbed into the skin however once absorbed it does NOTHING to improve the bruise or the skin.

This cream really works in eliminating bruises. I tried several other products and none compared to this one. I highly recommend it for people who may be on blood thinners and bruise easily  Bruises seem to disappear quickly with this cream!  Definitely will buy again when I run out as I bruise all the time.

I have the kind of skin that bruises easily with every bump.  This cream begins to soften the appearance overnight and, with use several times a day, the spot is gone in a week. I've tried virtually everything and this is the best bruise cream I've ever found.

This stuff is amazing! I get red bruises on my arms at the slightest touch. Tried so many products and nothing really worked. Decided to give this a try and Wow in 2-3 days marks were gone. Best stuff I’ve ever tried and worth every penny!
Aging creates frequent, ugly bruises. This cream isn't magic, but bruises do resolve more quickly when you use it,

AMAZING!!  After a 10 hour and another 5 hour surgery my surgeons told me some of my bruising could be permanent and I setbout to prove them wrong!!  I’ve used this product for 1 day! 1day, and my bruising is almost entirely gone!!!! This is miracle cream!

I’m on blood thinners and always getting bruises around my ankles. I rub the bruise Creme on my bruises and it DRASTICALLY reduces the heal time! Wow - love this. I don’t have to hide my bruises anymore.

I purchased this because I have purpura, it is a light moisturizer that I use with other creams and ointments to try to reduce the time it takes for a bruise to fade. Apply as directed for full effect.
I’ve used this as directed for 24 days now and no improvement on either the one year-old bruises I had or a couple of smaller ones I got in the interim. Disappointing; don’t waste your money.
Goes on kinda clumpy. The dermatologist told me probably the massaging it on is what breaks up the bruise, not so much whatever is in the cream. it’s ok. won’t buy again.

claims.text: Most reviewers report that the cream clears bruises quickly, often within days or even 48 hours.
Several reviewers say it works better than other arnica-based bruise products they have tried.
A few reviewers note the cream's tan color can leave a brown residue or temporarily cover the bruise rather than visibly reducing it.
Some reviewers find it overpriced or not worth the cost compared to cheaper alternatives.
A few reviewers mention using it for other skin concerns like rosacea, acne, or as a facial moisturizer.
